xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5357: Sequencer commits .pan/backlog/sequence.md every 1-3 minutes with only timestamp changes (41 no-op commits in 3 hours)

plan.title: Sequencer commits .pan/backlog/sequence.md every 1-3 minutes with only timestamp changes (41 no-op commits in 3 hours)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The dashboard spawns a fresh sequencer-runner agent 30 s after every burst of issues.delta events (src/lib/backlog/backlog-auto-trigger.ts, called from src/dashboard/server/read-model.ts), and pan backlog write-sequence always rewrites, commits and pushes .pan/backlog/sequence.md with a new generatedAt. A run that changes nothing still makes a two-line commit to main. The 42-second spacing suggests the loop feeds itself: each push moves main, which changes derived read-model state and emits another issues.delta. That is an unverified hypothesis; each fix layer stops the churn without it. Result: 41 no-op commits in 3 hours on 2026-11-15. That churn starves the merge train and forces every worktree to merge noise.
narratives.Proposal: Fix three layers (full detail and before/after code in .pan/drafts/PAN-5357.md). (1) writeSequenceMd renders deterministically (nodes sorted by rank, issue, then JSON text; edges by from, to, type, source, then confidence) and returns { written: false } without writing when the rendering differs from the prior file only in generatedAt; on every AI write (written or unchanged) it copies manifest.json to the gitignored .pan/backlog/examined-manifest.json, and on an unchanged AI write it bumps the mtime so the fresh-sequence done signal still fires. Operator edits never write the examined copy. (2) pan backlog write-sequence moves into src/cli/commands/backlog-write-sequence.ts; it still calls commitPlanArtifacts (which commits nothing for an untouched file but retries an earlier uncommitted write) and pushPlanArtifacts, and prints 'unchanged ... not committed' when nothing was written or committed. (3) spawnSequencerAgent gains skipWhenUnchanged: when the new manifest's key equals examined-manifest.json's key it returns null and spawns nothing; a failed spawn restores the prior manifest.json. (4) The auto-trigger passes skipWhenUnchanged and enforces a 30-minute minimum interval after an automatic pass that actually spawned, coalescing in-window deltas into one fire at the window end. (5) The sequencer prompt and roles/sequencer.md treat 'unchanged' as success. (6) Docs: docs/XBRIEF.md, reference/troubleshooting.mdx, changelog.d/pan-5357.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Filtering issues.delta by project or field in src/dashboard/server/read-model.ts
- Changing the merge train's reassembly on main moves (filed separately)
- A config key for the 30-minute interval or the 30 s debounce
- Delaying, rate-limiting or skipping the dashboard regenerate button (POST /api/backlog/sequence/regenerate) or any operator-started pass
- Changing the operator gate/planning routes in src/dashboard/server/routes/backlog.ts beyond what the new writeSequenceMd return type requires (nothing)
- Changing the incremental prompt's updatedAt-versus-generatedAt re-read rule
- Rewriting or squashing the existing no-op commits on main
- Skipping commitPlanArtifacts or pushPlanArtifacts on an unchanged write (both must still run)
- Fixing the pre-existing polyrepo mismatch where spawnSequencerAgent writes manifest.json under projectRoot/.pan while writeSequenceMd resolves the plan home

autoDecisions.summary: The automatic skip compares the new manifest to .pan/backlog/examined-manifest.json, a copy that only the sequencer's submission path (writeSequenceMd without operatorEdit) writes; not issue updatedAt versus prior generatedAt as the issue comment suggested, and not manifest.json or file mtimes.
autoDecisions.rationale: The writer fix freezes generatedAt on unchanged passes, so the updatedAt rule would never skip again after any comment. manifest.json is written at spawn time, so a pass that died before submitting would leave a matching file behind. Operator gate/planning edits also write sequence.md, so mtimes prove nothing. The submission-path copy advances only when a pass actually submitted.

autoDecisions.summary: An unchanged write still calls commitPlanArtifacts and pushPlanArtifacts, as the CLI does today.
autoDecisions.rationale: An untouched file gives git nothing to commit, so no-op commits stop anyway. Keeping both calls preserves recovery: a write whose commit failed earlier is committed on the re-run, and the troubleshooting.mdx recovery (re-run write-sequence after a failed push) still pushes. pushPlanArtifacts pushes nothing when nothing is ahead, so origin/main does not move.

autoDecisions.summary: Change detection byte-compares a deterministic rendering with generatedAt pinned to the prior value, and every other field (model, pass, lastReviewPass, openCount, node fields, edge set) counts as a change.
autoDecisions.rationale: Byte comparison avoids undefined-versus-missing-key mismatches in a hand-written deep-equal; sorting nodes and edges removes false differences from agent array order. Only the timestamp is noise according to the issue.

autoDecisions.summary: The 30-minute window starts only when an automatic pass actually spawned an agent; skipped, failed and suppressed fires leave it closed.
autoDecisions.rationale: A skipped check costs no agent and must not delay sequencing a real change that arrives a minute later; failed fires spawn nothing and are cheap to retry on the next delta.

autoDecisions.summary: The interval is a hardcoded constant MIN_AUTO_PASS_INTERVAL_MS = 30 * 60_000, as the issue comment suggested, with no config key.
autoDecisions.rationale: No one asked for configurability; the Karpathy rules forbid speculative configuration.

autoDecisions.summary: On an unchanged AI write, writeSequenceMd bumps sequence.md's mtime with utimesSync; on an unchanged operator edit it does not touch the file.
autoDecisions.rationale: getSequencerRunStatus marks a pass done when sequence.md's mtime is at or after startedAt; without the bump, no-op passes would finish only through the slower idle path. Git ignores mtime. Operator edits can run while a pass is live and must not falsely finish it.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 in .pan/drafts/PAN-5357.md. In src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts: add utimesSync and copyFileSync to the node:fs import; extract a private renderSequenceMd(doc) from the current lines 131-142 that sorts nodes by rank, then issue (localeCompare), then JSON.stringify(node), and serializes the JSON block as { ...doc, nodes: sortedNodes, edges: sortEdges(doc.edges) } with edges sorted by from, to, type, source, then numeric confidence; read the prior file once at the top regardless of operatorEdit (keep merge preservation gated on !opts?.operatorEdit); before writing, if the prior file parsed OK and renderSequenceMd({ ...mergedDoc, generatedAt: prior.generatedAt }) === priorText, then when !opts?.operatorEdit bump mtime/atime with utimesSync and call recordExaminedManifest(outPath), and return { written: false }; otherwise write, call recordExaminedManifest(outPath) when !opts?.operatorEdit, and return { written: true }. recordExaminedManifest copies <dir of sequence.md>/manifest.json to <same dir>/examined-manifest.json when manifest.json exists. Export interface WriteSequenceMdResult { written: boolean }. In .gitignore add '.pan/backlog/examined-manifest.json' below the '.pan/backlog/manifest.json' line with the PRD's comment. Add the seven tests named in WI-1 to src/lib/backlog/__tests__/write-sequence.test.ts.

Add the tests named in WI-3; in spawn-sequencer.test.ts create the project root with mkdtemp from node:fs/promises (node:fs is mocked in that file, node:fs/promises is not) and override the collectOpenBacklog mock to return a non-null priorSequence.

metadata.sizeJustification: One inseparable fix touching 15 files: the spawner's skip (src/lib/backlog/sequencer-agent.ts) reads examined-manifest.json, which only the writer (src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts) creates and only .gitignore keeps out of commits. The CLI test exercises the writer, and the docs, role prompt and changelog describe this one behavior. Shipping any slice alone either leaves no-op commits on main or adds a skip with no watermark. The seventh subsystem is only the root .gitignore line.
